title: AI-Enhanced Predictive Modeling for Identifying Depression and Delirium in Cardiovascular Patients Scheduled for Cardiac Surgery.
summary: The study evaluated the classifiers on its reported diagnostic cohort with internal train/test assessment; performance is limited to that cohort and reference labels. The finding remains bounded to the source study.
ai_technology: Random-forest and logistic-regression models use clinical and laboratory predictors to classify the reported diagnostic outcome.
